title: Computer Science Summer Institute (CSSI)
description: Three-week intensive introduction to computer science for rising high school seniors from underrepresented backgrounds. Project-based curriculum covering web development, algorithms, and collaboration.

title: STEM Enhancement in Earth Science (SEES)
description: National high school internship pairing remote Earth science research with an on-site summer experience at UT Austin. Students analyze NASA satellite data and present findings.

title: Student Leaders Internship
location: Local community nonprofits across the US
description: Paid eight-week summer internship for rising high school juniors and seniors placed at local nonprofits, plus a leadership summit in Washington, D.C.

title: High School Internship Program
description: Paid summer internship for rising high school seniors interested in software engineering, product design, and technical program management at Microsoft.

title: High School Summer Internship Program (HIP)
location: Bethesda, MD and other NIH campuses
description: Full-time summer research internships for high school students in biomedical laboratories across NIH institutes. Strong fit for students exploring medicine or life sciences.

title: Meta Engaging in Engineering Program
location: Menlo Park, CA / select US offices
description: Hands-on engineering exposure program for high school students focusing on coding fundamentals, product thinking, and mentorship from Meta engineers.

title: High School Internships
description: Museum and research internships for high school students across Smithsonian museums and research centers, spanning history, art, culture, and natural science.

title: Academy of Math and Programming (AMP)
description: Selective summer academy for high school students combining functional programming, probability, and problem solving with traders and engineers.

title: SHTEM Summer Internship
description: Research-focused summer internship pairing high school students with Stanford labs across science, humanities, engineering, and design topics.

title: Youth Research & Clinical Exposure Program
description: Hospital-affiliated program for grades 10–12 combining supervised clinical shadowing, public health projects, and mentorship from residents and research staff.

title: High School Tech Internships
location: New York, Chicago, and partner cities
description: Paid tech internships for high school students who complete Code Nation programming tracks, placed with industry partners on real web projects.

title: Educational Partnership Program / High School Opportunities
location: Various US labs and field sites
description: NOAA education pathways and high school research experiences focused on climate, oceans, weather, and environmental monitoring.
